Shakeout

Shakeout, a single-player dice game for Android. Built and signed by the release workflow of https://github.com/jpsutton/shakeout.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://jpsutton.github.io/shakeout/fdroid/repo
